scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @metricas-dspd/contratos --filter @metricas-dspd/metricas --filter @metricas-dspd/mock --filter @metricas-dspd/web --filter @metricas-dspd/server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @metricas-dspd/e2e exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.format: prettier --write web packages eslint.config.js tsconfig.base.json package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check web packages eslint.config.js tsconfig.base.json package.json
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run format:check
scripts.pronto: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm -r --if-present run pronto
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && pnpm run db:up
